verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs are served as raw Markdown pages (e.g. linear.app/developers/graphql.md, agents.md, webhooks.md, aig.md), which an agent can ingest directly. There is also a dedicated guide on integrating AI agents and agent-interaction guidelines. However, no llms.txt index is evidenced, and nothing explicitly positions the docs as agent-consumable. Missing for 10: a documented llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, explicit first-party statement that docs are offered in agent-oriented form, and hands-on corroboration of agents consuming them.
